sources.title: Gemma Model Family - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: The family has two halves. A mainline generation — Gemma 1 through Gemma 4 — is the general purpose model most people want. Around each generation sits a set of variants: the same architecture retrained or restructured for one job, like embeddings, safety classification or vision-language tasks.

sources.title: Gemma 3 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 3 is the most capable model that can run on a single GPU or TPU. Efficient on workstations, laptops, and even smartphones, allowing developers to build responsible AI applications at scale.

sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.
